title: Crash on changing Overview graph granularity
body:
When changing the granularity of the graph on the Overview tab, AAPS crashes.

0 AAPS is looping / graph is set to display 'basals' and 'activity' with no other graphs (graph1, graph2,...) enabled
1 Tap-hold on the graph to change granularity
--> after performing step 1 two or three times, AAPS crashes 

Note that the issue can be consistently replicated.
--------------
Tested on AAPS 3.0 B5, running on an S7/Android 11 (Pixel Experience) connected to MDT 554 via RileyLink
Logs shared directly with Milos. Logs were generated after restarting AAPS immediately after the crash occurred.

comments.body:
i improved UI much after beta5 and now i cannot replicate. but it can have another reason.
update this issue after you test it with beta6 (when released) or current dev

Tested on 2.8.2.10-dev build 2021-11-11 11:40 and the issues are partially resolved (it no longer crashes). Tap-hold once always works as expected. But tap-hold 2 or 3 times results in:
1) the UI doesn't respond immediately to the 2nd/3rd tap-hold (always)
2) the Android dialog 'AndroidAPS isn't responding' appears (often)

From an end user perspective, it seems as if AAPS is doing something CPU-intensive after switching granularity once, and attempting to switch again while that background activity is going on doesn't put a stop to that activity, resulting in the the UI being non-responsive.

I've shared new logs illustrating this with the above build.

Tested this PR ( #911 ) on 2.8.2.10dev 2021-11-14-12:49, and it resolves the performance issues. i.e.
- the UI now responds consistently to Tap-hold actions
- tap-hold actions no longer trigger the 'AndroidAPS isn't responding' dialog
Note: My previous comment might be misleading--PR #911 isn't yet included with AAPS 3.0. It's a work in progress, tracked at #801.
